set(_simd -mavx2 -mfma)
function(_helper t)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${_simd})
endfunction()
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${_simd})
string(REPLACE "/arch:SSE2" "/arch:AVX2" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "-O2" "-O2 -mavx2" CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
string(REPLACE "-mavx2" "" CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS "${CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS}")
string(JOIN " " _joined ${_simd})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${_joined})
function(_late_helper t)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${_late})
  set(_inner -mbmi2)
  set(_up -mbmi2 PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
set(_late -mf16c)
_late_helper(helios_y)
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${_inner})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${_up})
macro(_setup)
  set(_mflags -mavx2)
endmacro()
_setup()
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${_mflags})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${HELIOS_ISA_MIXED})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${HELIOS_ISA_MACRO})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${HELIOS_ISA_COPY})
target_compile_options(helios_y PRIVATE ${HELIOS_ISA_LOOPED})
